name: Chuleta de SQL
description: Referencia con búsqueda de sintaxis SQL: SELECT, JOIN, filtros, agregación, DDL, funciones de ventana y transacciones.

strings.Quick reference for SQL syntax, searchab: Referencia rápida de sintaxis SQL, con búsqueda por categoría o palabra clave.
strings.All columns from a table: Todas las columnas de una tabla
strings.SELECT col1 AS alias FROM table: SELECT col1 AS alias FROM table
strings.SELECT col FROM table LIMIT n: SELECT col FROM table LIMIT n
strings.SELECT col FROM table LIMIT n OFFSET m: SELECT col FROM table LIMIT n OFFSET m
strings.SELECT col FROM table ORDER BY col ASC|D: SELECT col FROM table ORDER BY col ASC|DESC
strings.SELECT col FROM table WHERE condition: SELECT col FROM table WHERE condition
strings.SELECT a.* FROM a CROSS JOIN b: SELECT a.* FROM a CROSS JOIN b
strings.Anti-join (rows in a not in b): Anti-join (filas de a que no están en b)
strings.Match any of a set: Coincidir con cualquiera de un conjunto
strings.WHERE col BETWEEN v1 AND v2: WHERE col BETWEEN v1 AND v2
strings.SELECT col, COUNT(*) FROM table GROUP BY: SELECT col, COUNT(*) FROM table GROUP BY col
strings.SELECT col, SUM(amount) FROM table GROUP: SELECT col, SUM(amount) FROM table GROUP BY col
strings.SELECT col, AVG(price) FROM table GROUP: SELECT col, AVG(price) FROM table GROUP BY col
strings.SELECT col, MIN(col2), MAX(col2) FROM ta: SELECT col, MIN(col2), MAX(col2) FROM table GROUP BY col
strings.SELECT col, GROUP_CONCAT(col2) FROM tabl: SELECT col, GROUP_CONCAT(col2) FROM table GROUP BY col
strings.SELECT col, STRING_AGG(col2, \",\") FROM: SELECT col, STRING_AGG(col2, ",") FROM table GROUP BY col
strings.INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v: INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v2)
strings.INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) SELECT c1, c2: INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) SELECT c1, c2 FROM other
strings.INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v: INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
strings.Empty table fast (no rollback): Vaciar una tabla rápido (sin vuelta atrás)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name: CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255))
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PR: CREATE TABLE t (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY): CREATE TABLE t (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY A: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INT, FOREIGN KEY (id): CREATE TABLE t (id INT, FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES other(id))
strings.ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN col VARCHAR(100: ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN col VARCHAR(100)
strings.ALTER TABLE t DROP COLUMN col: ALTER TABLE t DROP COLUMN col
strings.ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN old TO new: ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN old TO new
strings.CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx ON table(col): CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx ON table(col)
strings.WITH cte AS (SELECT ...) SELECT * FROM c: WITH cte AS (SELECT ...) SELECT * FROM cte
strings.WITH RECURSIVE cte AS (...) SELECT * FRO: WITH RECURSIVE cte AS (...) SELECT * FROM cte
strings.SELECT col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY: SELECT col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY col) FROM t
strings.SELECT col, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g: SELECT col, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY col) FROM t
strings.SELECT col, LAG(col) OVER (ORDER BY col): SELECT col, LAG(col) OVER (ORDER BY col) FROM t
strings.SELECT col, LEAD(col) OVER (ORDER BY col: SELECT col, LEAD(col) OVER (ORDER BY col) FROM t
strings.SELECT col, FIRST_VALUE(col) OVER (PARTI: SELECT col, FIRST_VALUE(col) OVER (PARTITION BY g) FROM t
strings.SELECT CASE WHEN c1 THEN v1 ELSE v2 END: SELECT CASE WHEN c1 THEN v1 ELSE v2 END FROM t
strings.SELECT COALESCE(col1, col2, default) FRO: SELECT COALESCE(col1, col2, default) FROM t
strings.MERGE INTO target USING source ON condit: MERGE INTO target USING source ON condition WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE ...
strings.SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COM: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
